calls.reason: ETR's January 2026 survey of 600 tech leaders found half say AI value outweighs cost. That is far from 'effectively every' company. KPMG shows widespread cost problems, not near-universal failure.
NVIDIA's Q1 FY27 filing confirms three direct customers made up 54% of revenue. The main point, that this shows an unhealthy or unsustainable industry, is a judgement the evidence does not settle.

No evidence establishes the 75% compute share, the over-50% backlog share, or misleading accounting. The Sightline construction data is a forecast and Anthropic's loss disclosure covers one company, so too little is verified.
Stated as a belief. The evidence is estimates at API prices (The Decoder, SemiAnalysis via Tom's Hardware) and an older Altman post, not the companies' actual serving costs per heavy subscriber.

Anthropic's S-1 shows its cost-to-revenue ratio falling and revenue growing far faster than compute costs, which weighs against linear scaling. But the size of the May–June discount is unknown, so the 'only reason' claim can't be tested.
